incident.description: Network partition caused split-brain between East and West data centers. Orchestrator Raft quorum in West DC promoted a local replica as new primary while East DC primary continued accepting writes.

resolution_rules.update_update: Last-Writer-Wins (LWW): for rows modified on both sides, keep the version with the later updated_at timestamp. The full row from the winning side replaces the losing side entirely.
resolution_rules.insert_insert_pk_conflict: East-Primary: the East DC insert retains its original primary key. The West DC insert is reassigned to the next available primary key value (MAX(id)+1 across all inserts).
resolution_rules.delete_vs_update: Data-Preservation: if one side DELETEd a row and the other side UPDATEd it, keep the UPDATEd version. Data integrity takes precedence over deletion.
resolution_rules.delete_vs_unchanged: Apply-Delete: if one side DELETEd a row and the other side did not touch it, apply the deletion.
resolution_rules.repository_counters: For the repositories table specifically: stars and forks are monotonically increasing counters. When the same repository row is modified on both sides, take MAX(east_value, west_value) for stars and forks independently, and MAX(east_updated_at, west_updated_at) for the timestamp. Other columns come from the version with the later updated_at.
resolution_rules.non_conflicting: Apply all non-conflicting writes from both sides as-is.
